data.scope: Approximation, source-moment and parameter-identifiability probes only. No DG evolution, solver residual, GPU time, dynamic stability, front tracking or arbitrary-flow closure claim.

data.accounting: Nodal and conserved-mass fits have different observations and are not equivalent algorithms: the latter requires an evolved conservative mean, not a quadrature estimate from underresolved point samples. End states, shape and alpha are known prior information. The fit cannot identify arbitrary shock shapes from one number. Distorted data are prescribed positive full-energy states, not exact stationary IGR solutions. Polynomial source uses broken velocity derivatives; jumps are not squared as distributions.
